answer: Reputation here is a crystal escrow graph: a new identity's weight equals bonds posted by independent, previously unrelated counterparties, and each bond is slashed if its holder is later shown to run a clone. A single backer vouching for many aliases is exposed instantly, because shared escrow edges reveal the farm. To manufacture n credible aliases an attacker must recruit n separate backers holding real stake with no overlap between them, so cost scales per alias instead of amortizing, and a raven rehearsing a borrowed past meets umber silence when no unlinked bond answers for it.
